package: G09 产品依赖、许可证与离线分发清单（SDK + 十三个可选应用包）
scope: Installed reading SDK file inventory, registered licence materials and observed static/dynamic dependencies on three desktop operating systems. Mobile packaging, host bundles, signing and publication are not covered.

profiles.reading: reading-core and reading-library install the SDK only: no audio codec, no WebView, no credential module, no optional application package
profiles.combined: reading-library plus the thirteen optional application packages installed into one prefix, explicitly registered with their own archives, headers, package configuration and licence material

sbom_schemas.validation: jsonschema 4.x against the published schemas in the report job, for all nine installs

licence_record.reused: tools/check_reading_licenses.py (COMPONENTS) and the shared stage check
licence_record.optional_packages: each of the thirteen packages resolves to an installed MIT text: webdav and credentials install their own copy, the other eleven rely on share/exreader/LICENSE in the same prefix

static_dependency.method: ar t / lib /list members, nm -g / dumpbin /symbols symbol sets, dumpbin /directives, undefined-to-defined intersection, and the real Ninja link command of a consumer that links exactly one installed package

exclusions_verified.audio_and_gpl_options: EXR_ENABLE_AUDIO, EXR_ENABLE_MP3, EXR_ENABLE_AAC all OFF in every install; no audio layer, archive or licence
exclusions_verified.webview: no web engine file, exported target or native dependency in either profile
exclusions_verified.test_credentials: the reading installs export no credential target; the combined prefix contains exactly the registered credential package and nothing else
exclusions_verified.test_secrets: no PEM private key or access-key shape in any installed byte
exclusions_verified.build_machine_paths: none in any generated SBOM; 60 distinct installed files still carry one (see release_blockers)

archives.windows: every installed .lib, including the thirteen package archives

release_blockers.owner: root: a shared document, the fetched projects' install rules and the protected build configuration

not_covered: Android, iOS and Apple native host packaging: separate owners, not built or packed here
GTK/Linux, Windows and macOS native host bundles and their Noto Sans CJK host font
Audio builds: EXR_ENABLE_AUDIO and the MP3/AAC codecs are excluded from the reading presets
PDF editing, text index, shared compatibility library, JNI bindings, tools and test binaries
Offline installer, code signing, notarization, tag, Release and store publication
Legal review: the registered licence identifiers are inventoried, not adjudicated
Audio builds: EXR_ENABLE_AUDIO and the MP3/AAC codecs are excluded from every profile
